propositions: The compromised GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN must be rotated after deploy 66af (Gerrit 1384) is deployed to production to prevent re-logging the new token in plaintext.
The review-bot currently sources the token from the URL query parameter ?token= and logs it unredacted in uvicorn access logs; 66af moves this to the X-Rebar-Token header with redaction.

The token is a shared secret used for outbound Gerrit HTTP basic-auth, inbound webhook authentication, and container environment configuration; rotation must use service-user.sh to keep all three synchronized.

Token rotation requires: deploy current main, run service-user.sh to set new password/SSM/webhooks.config, restart the container, and verify end-to-end webhook and outbound LLM-Review vote functionality.
